jobs.title: Principal AI Engineer
jobs.description: Interested candidates can share their resume to - Sabana.khanam@careernet.in Role & responsibilities About the role We are building an AI-powered operating model for Ocean Operations and a next-generation optimisation capability for global Network Design. This role is not limited to agent orchestration or execution workflows. It is a senior technical leadership role for how AI strengthens optimisation methods, modelling, and decision quality across both planning and execution. The remit is broader than a standalone AI feature set. It covers how AI, optimisation, and engineering come together to deliver better network decisions at scale, while also shaping agentic decision systems in Control Tower style execution environments. Role purpose The Principal AI Engineer will set the technical direction for AI-augmented optimisation and intelligent operational decisioning. This person will lead through specialists in optimisation, modelling, heuristics, analytics, and experimentation. They will define where AI can materially improve search, structural recommendations, and solver-backed workflows, while also guiding the design of multi-agent systems for reasoning, orchestration, exception handling, and human-in-the-loop execution. What you will own • Technical direction for AI-augmented optimisation and agentic decision systems across Network Design and operational execution • How planning problems are framed and where AI can improve search, candidate generation, structural recommendations, and decision quality • The interface between AI systems, heuristics, solver layers, optimisation services, and enterprise workflows • Patterns for when AI should recommend, act autonomously, or escalate to humans • The quality bar for experimentation, evaluation, and translation of new methods into measurable value for planners and decision-makers • Reusable intelligence patterns that can scale across both Control Tower and Network Design use cases Key responsibilities • Lead the optimisation intelligence agenda across network design, routing, vessel deployment, cargo flow, and operational decisioning • Set direction for how teams define problem structures, formulate optimisation approaches, design heuristics, and identify where AI can improve search, modelling quality, and decision outcomes Classification: Internal • Guide specialists building optimisation models, analytical components, and AI capabilities, ensuring their work fits into a coherent AI plus OR architecture • Drive structured experimentation to compare alternative methods, validate model behaviour, and improve performance, robustness, and scalability • Define how AI systems should interact with solver layers, heuristics, and optimisation services rather than treating AI as a separate layer • Lead the use of agentic AI where it adds value to reasoning, orchestration, exception handling, and human-in-the-loop decision support • Shape the innovation roadmap by identifying promising new methods and accelerating them into pilots and scaled capabilities • Raise standards across modelling practice, technical quality, experimentation discipline, and architectural judgment • Communicate assumptions, trade-offs, and limitations clearly to senior stakeholders and decision makers What we are looking for We are looking for a senior technical leader with deep credibility across both AI and optimisation, and with the ability to lead through highly skilled specialists rather than doing all modelling work personally. jobs.title: Agentic AI Engineer
jobs.description: Job Summary As an Agentic AI Engineer at Hudson Data, you will design, build, and ship LLM-powered agents that do real work: researching cases, analysing data, calling tools and APIs, and automating multi-step workflows for our products and for lenders and fintech partners. You will own agents end to end, from prompt and tool design through orchestration, evaluation, deployment, and monitoring in production. You will work closely with our data science, data engineering, and product teams, and help set how Hudson Data builds with AI. This is a full-time, onsite role in Gurugram, India. Responsibilities Design and build LLM-based agents and multi-agent workflows that plan, use tools, call APIs and databases, and complete multi-step tasks reliably. Build retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines over structured and unstructured data, including chunking, embeddings, vector search, and re-ranking. Design clear tool interfaces (function calling, MCP servers) that connect agents to internal systems, data warehouses, and third-party services. Build evaluation harnesses: test sets, automated and LLM-as-judge evals, regression tests, and red-teaming, so agent quality is measured, not guessed. Take agents to production with solid engineering: APIs, background jobs, retries, cost and latency controls, logging, tracing, and monitoring. Put guardrails in place: permissions, human-in-the-loop review, prompt-injection defences, PII handling, and audit trails suitable for financial-services clients. Choose the right model for each job across providers (Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, open-weight models), balancing quality, cost, and latency. Work with data scientists to combine agents with predictive models, for example agents that investigate fraud alerts or explain credit decisions. Keep up with a fast-moving field and bring the useful ideas into our stack. Required qualifications 3+ years of software engineering experience, including at least 1 year building applications on top of LLMs. Strong Python, with experience building production backend services and APIs (FastAPI or similar). Hands-on experience building agents or LLM workflows: function/tool calling, structured outputs, prompt design, and at least one orchestration approach (e.g. LangGraph, LlamaIndex, OpenAI Agents SDK, Claude Agent SDK, or your own). Experience with RAG and vector databases (e.g. pgvector, Pinecone, Weaviate, Qdrant). Experience evaluating LLM systems and improving them based on measured results. Solid SQL and comfort working with real, messy business data. Experience with cloud platforms (GCP or AWS), Docker, Git, and CI/CD. Ability to own problems end to end and explain technical trade-offs clearly. Preferred qualifications Bachelors or Masters degree in computer science or a related field. Experience building MCP servers or integrating agents with enterprise systems. Experience with observability tools for LLM apps (e.g. LangSmith, Langfuse, Arize, OpenTelemetry). Strong experience designing scalable APIs and services (REST/FastAPI), containerization (Docker/Kubernetes), CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure as code.
